fact: Botswana told the Human Rights Committee on 20 March 2025 that asylum-seekers are issued proof of registration and identity cards on arrival; stakeholders said on 1 December 2025 that the 2024 Refugees Act, which provides refugee identification documents, had not yet entered into force.
title: Report on follow-up to the concluding observations of the Human Rights Committee: Addendum, Botswana (CCPR/C/145/R.1/Add.1)
